hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-forest-900
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-forest-900

surfaces.image_treatment: clipped frames with subtle 1px border-forest-900/10, inner shadow

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load using Framer Motion (initial y: 100%, opacity: 0, animate y: 0, opacity: 1, transition: cubic-bezier).
motion.scroll_momentum: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.parallax: Subtle y-axis translate on hero images based on scroll position.
motion.marquee: Slow, smooth editorial marquee running continuously across the screen.
motion.hover: Buttons and cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow and subtle border color change.

marketing.hero: Full height (min-h-screen) with massive kinetic typography and a beautifully clipped product image (orchard / weather station).
marketing.manifesto: Numbered editorial chapters (01, 02, 03). Use asymmetric CSS grid layout. Alternate left/right alignment with generous negative space.
marketing.marquee: Full-width editorial marquee strip with large uppercase text.
marketing.pricing: Bento-style 3-column grid for Free Trial, Annual, and Lifetime. Highlight the Lifetime tier with a subtle glowing tracing beam effect.

dashboard.grid: High-density Bento grid for weather stats (Temp, Humidity, Rain, Wind).
dashboard.spacing: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for data correlation. Full pixel utilization.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for marketing, standard rounded (rounded-lg) for dashboard. High contrast text.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts for Ecowitt weather data (line charts for temperature/humidity trends).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs customized with light background and focus:ring-leaf-DEFAULT.
components.toasts: Sonner for notifications (e.g., 'Consiglio AI generato', 'Stazione meteo sincronizzata').

hero_orchard.description: Apple orchard background for hero section

weather_station.description: Weather station for Ecowitt integration section

farmer_app.description: Farmer holding tablet to showcase the app usage

fruits_detail.description: Close up of oranges for phenological phases section

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Recharts.
Language MUST be Italian. 'Il Tuo Frutteto, Guidato dalla Natura e dai Dati.'
Implement routing to switch between the Marketing Landing Page and the App Dashboard demo.
In the Marketing Page, use 'Lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Implement the signature on-load hero text reveal using Framer Motion (masked text effect).
Ensure generous spacing on the marketing page (p-12, p-24) to achieve the editorial Awwwards aesthetic.
In the Dashboard, implement a clean, dense bento grid for the Ecowitt weather data and plant management.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Apply 'Cabinet Grotesk' for primary headings and 'Cormorant Garamond' for elegant serif accents (e.g., quotes, chapter numbers).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements and z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for sticky headers.
Avoid applying universal transitions like 'transition: all'. Add specific transitions.
Do not center align the main App container.
Incorporate hover states, micro-animations, and entrance animations for all lists and buttons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for marketing sections.
